scope: Three date-fix acceptance questions: original R1, an explicit reference-date comparison, and the original overdue query. Only questions are sent to the model; criteria require separate review.

cases.question: 只查销售发票 ACC-SINV-2026-00018 的当前未结余额、总额、币种和状态，简短回答。若两个金额相等，能据此说它从未收款或没有核销历史吗？不要额外查付款流水。
review_criteria: Outstanding USD5760 is explicitly an unpaid balance, not an absent net difference
No inference of payment or allocation history
No unsolicited due-date explanation or history query

cases.question: 销售发票 ACC-SINV-2026-00018 按业务参考日 2025-10-15 是否逾期？请核对到期日、当前未结余额，区分 ERP 原始 status 和按参考日的判断，简短回答，不查付款历史。
review_criteria: Program evidence states due date after reference date and overdue false
Raw ERP status Overdue is preserved and identified separately
Outstanding USD5760 remains unpaid, not evidence of never-paid history

cases.question: Show me overdue sales invoices.
review_criteria: Correct reference date and date/balance assessment, not raw-status filtering
Submitted invoice scope, company and currency are supported
Each listed amount and total has tool evidence with complete query scope
No unrequested historical-payment or causal explanation
